title: AOSP 内存源码阅读路径：ART、AMS、lmkd、kernel、mmd
key_conclusions: AOSP memory source reading should start from stable runtime evidence and a specific bucket.
ART, AMS, lmkd, kernel mm, and vendor mmd form a chain; one source module rarely explains the whole incident.
Every source conclusion needs a target Android branch, kernel version, ROM boundary, and matching observable signal.
Vendor memory extension and mmd behavior must not be presented as generic AOSP behavior.
shallow_points: The article lists source paths and search commands but does not validate them against a checked-out AOSP branch.
It does not include real lmkd, PSI, or mmd logs from a device.
It does not compare exact code movement across Android 5.0 through 17.
It does not provide a runnable script that maps evidence buckets to source queries.
discovered_connections: Day 73's evidence-to-source mapping becomes the organizing principle for all source reading.
Day 72's branch/version validation gap expands into explicit AOSP tag, kernel version, ROM, and build-type fields.
Day 68's cross-validation remains necessary before jumping from source code to owner attribution.
Day 75 should use this source map to explain how memory behavior changed across Android versions.
suggest_future_topics: Day 75 should focus on Android version evolution from 5.0 to 17 and highlight ART, lmkd, PSI, MGLRU, ZRAM, and tooling shifts.
A future appendix should validate all source paths against a concrete AOSP checkout and tag.
A future tool should translate meminfo/smaps/lmkd symptoms into rg commands automatically.
A future case should attach real device logs to the source-reading template.
knowledge_gaps: Need a local AOSP checkout to confirm exact paths, symbols, and branch-specific code movement.
Need real device evidence for lmkd statsd atoms, kernel PSI, zram writeback, and vendor mmd.
Need Android 5.0 to 17 version matrix with verified feature introduction dates and defaults.
Need permission-boundary checks for user, userdebug, and eng builds.
applied_reflections: Applied Day 73's next-run instruction by focusing on ART, AMS, lmkd, kernel, and mmd source-reading paths.
Applied Day 73's evidence-to-source mapping by organizing source paths around observed symptoms, commands, buckets, and validation points.
Applied Day 72's version-boundary gap by requiring AOSP tag, kernel version, ROM, and build-type notes before making source-backed claims.
Applied the standing more-diagrams-less-prose feedback by using four Mermaid diagrams, source matrices, command templates, and a source-note worksheet.
visible_changes: Added four Mermaid diagrams because of the more-diagrams-less-prose feedback: evidence-to-source map, source-reading path, AMS-lmkd-kernel sequence, and troubleshooting decision flow.
Added tables for symptoms to source paths, module reading priorities, ART entries, AMS/lmkd entries, kernel/mmd entries, version boundaries, source-note template, and engineering conclusions.
Added rg command templates for ART GC/class loading, AMS OomAdjuster/compaction/trim, lmkd PSI/kill logic, kernel reclaim/PSI/memcg, and ZRAM writeback.
